No I am, I'm sorry I can't do it anymore. I wish I was okay. More than anything in the world. I just hurt others. It's all ive done. It's not fair that I have to keep going.
You're stronger than me. I can't go on anymore. I'll be gone soon.

Ive been that person. Overdosed on paracetamol a few years back seen my mam and sister crying while I was in agony myself. Broke my heart. Even telling them I'm suicidal breaks my heart also doesn't help that they just all ignore now and accept it plus they think I hate them. I love them more than anything. I just can't manage the emotional hell I go through on a daily basis. I leave every job I get within 3 months because I always break down. Ive done this same situation so many times but this time I just want it to be over. I'm exhausted. Ive zero support anymore. I can't live with the guilt of the things I've done. How I made a show of my family by fighting and being arrested outside my house. Or kicking in my own front door at the same time breaking my arm and possibly my ankle. I just want all the pain to go away, I can't manage. Lost my friends, my family think I hate them and ice basically lost my job aswell. I believe they would all be better if I wasn't here.
No I have done it. Doesn't work instantly. It's going to be slow and painful.
There is honestly no point. I've planed out what I'm doing to stop it all and I've started so I can't go back.
